source.name: Oregon Department of Fish and Wildlife — 2026 Preference Point Draw Reports and Applicants by Hunt Choice reports

notes: ODFW 2026 controlled-hunt draw (results June 2026). Oregon draw: 75% of each hunt's tags go to first-choice applicants in order of preference points (Phase 1); the other 25% go at random to all remaining first-choice applicants (Phase 2). Nonresidents are capped at 5% of deer/elk tags and 3% of pronghorn tags per hunt (one NR tag allowed when a hunt has fewer than 35 tags). Deer (100 buck + 600 antlerless series), elk (200) and pronghorn (400) rows come from ODFW's 2026 Preference Point Draw Reports: https://myodfw.com/sites/default/files/2026-07/2026%20Buck%20Deer%20Preference%20Point%20Draw%20Report.xlsx ; https://myodfw.com/sites/default/files/2026-08/2026%20Antlerless%20Deer%20Preference%20Point%20Draw%20Report_0.xlsx ; https://myodfw.com/sites/default/files/2026-07/2026%20Elk%20Preference%20Point%20Draw%20Report.xlsx ; https://myodfw.com/sites/default/files/2026-07/2026%20Pronghorn%20Antelope%20Preference%20Point%20Draw%20Report.xlsx. tags = 'Tags Authorized' (total for the hunt; ODFW does not publish a per-hunt resident/nonresident tag split, so draw.*.tags is null). applicants = first-choice applicants; successPct = first-choice applicants drawn (Section A, both phases) / first-choice applicants x 100, computed here and rounded to 0.1. pointLines: per preference-point class, applicants = first-choice applicants, drawn = applicants drawn in the 75% PREFERENCE-POINT PHASE ONLY (ODFW's Section B covers Phase 1 only; Phase-2 random winners are not broken out by point class, so pointLines drawn adds up to about 75% of tags). minPoints = lowest point class that drew in Phase 1 (the preference cutoff); when every first-choice applicant of that residency drew, minPoints = lowest point class that applied. Applicants below minPoints can still draw in the 25% random phase. Two hunts (615 Willamette Unit antlerless, 470C Hart Mtn pronghorn) have inconsistent nonresident figures in ODFW's report (Section A shows 0 NR applicants but NR tags drawn); their nonresident stats are null. unit = WMU number as in ODFW's WildlifeManagementUnits layer (UNIT_NUM), read from the hunt number (series digit + 2-digit WMU, the convention ODFW states for premium hunts, e.g. L28 = Applegate Unit 28); units[] adds every WMU where ODFW's 2025 harvest summaries list the same hunt number. Hunts often cover only part of a WMU. Eastern Oregon deer hunts were rebuilt for 2026 around mule-deer hunt areas (e.g. DG102 = Devils Garden hunt area 02, buck series): unit = ODFW hunt-area ID ('DG02', as written in the Commission tables: 'All of Hunt Area DG02'). No official public boundary layer for these hunt areas was found, so these units will not match the WMU layer. Weapon: hunt name contains 'Bow' -> archery, 'Muzzleloader' -> muzzleloader, otherwise rifle (any legal weapon); no weapon for NB601/NE605 (archery/muzzleloader only) and premium/sheep/goat hunts. Premium hunts (L deer, M elk, N pronghorn: no points, equal-chance draw, open to nonresidents), bighorn sheep (500) and Rocky Mountain goat (900: no points; ram and goat tags once in a lifetime) only have ODFW 'Applicants by Hunt Choice' reports: https://myodfw.com/sites/default/files/2026-07/2026%20Premium%20Buck%20Deer%20Applicants%20by%20Hunt%20Choice.xlsx ; https://myodfw.com/sites/default/files/2026-07/2026%20Premium%20Elk%20Applicants%20by%20Hunt%20Choice.xlsx ; https://myodfw.com/sites/default/files/2026-07/2026%20Premium%20Pronghorn%20Antelope%20Applicants%20by%20Hunt%20Choice.xlsx ; https://myodfw.com/sites/default/files/2026-07/2026%20Bighorn%20Sheep%20Applicants%20by%20Hunt%20Choice.xlsx ; https://myodfw.com/sites/default/files/2026-07/2026%20Rocky%20Mountain%20Goat%20Applicants%20by%20Hunt%20Choice.xlsx. For these, applicants = 1st-choice applicants (residents and nonresidents combined); draw results by residency are not published, so successPct is null. Their tags are the 2026 tag numbers PROPOSED to the Fish and Wildlife Commission (Exhibit D Attachment 3 amendment, 9-9-2025, Appendices 5, 6 and 8: https://myodfw.com/sites/default/files/2025-09/Exhibit%20D_Attachment%203_Amendment_2026%20Staff%20Proposals_Big%20Game%20Regulations_REVISED_9-9-2025_.pdf), including the resident/nonresident split for sheep and goat; not cross-checked against the final printed 2026 regulations. 575A1 tags were unreadable (struck-through amendment) and are null; nonresident tags left blank in the proposal are null. Sheep/goat unit = WMU from the hunt number (e.g. 543 -> 43); sheep and goat hunt areas often span or cut across WMUs. Not included: spring bear (700), landowner preference, auction/raffle, tribal, outfitter-guide allocation, emergency and leftover tags. Oregon has no moose season.
